name: Smith Machine Close-Grip Bench Press
steps: Position a flat bench so the bar tracks over your lower chest and lie back with feet planted.
Set your shoulder blades against the pad, grasp the bar overhand at shoulder width and release the hooks.
Lower the bar slowly to your lower chest while keeping your elbows tucked close to your sides.
Press until your arms extend and rotate the bar onto the hooks when finished.
tips: Avoid placing your hands so narrowly that your wrists twist painfully inward.
Keep your elbows traveling forward and close to your ribs rather than flaring wide.
